title: tenant-econ-exporter-and-quant-diff-tooling: export tenant-level unit-econ snapshots and provide quant-profile diff utility
author: Priya Anand
commits: a1f3d9c: initial exporter scaffolding + proto definition
b2e4f11: implement snapshot serializer and secure export endpoint
c3a5b22: add quant-diff CLI and protobuf->json converter
d4c6a33: integrate exporter with batching defaults and telemetry pipeline
e5d7f44: tests, docs, and RBAC update for export role
description:
Motivation: Users asked for a lightweight way to inspect tenant-level unit economics (per-token cost, effective batching, cache hit rates) and compare quantization profile changes across deployments. This PR adds a tenant-level unit-econ snapshot exporter and a small CLI to compute diffs between quant profiles so SREs and Platform Engineers can validate cost regressions before rolling quantized variants into Dedicated/Private deployments.

What this PR does (high level): adds a secure telemetry exporter that emits periodic tenant snapshots (schema v1) containing usage histograms, unit-economic aggregates, batching shape summaries, and compact quant-profile fingerprints; introduces tools/quant-diff which loads two quant-profile artifacts and reports a prioritized list of cost/latency/risk deltas with heuristics for when a profile is safe to promote. Also wires a lightweight default into batching_defaults.yaml to enable sampling for new tenants.

Checklist: - [x] exporter proto + server-side handler - [x] quant-diff CLI with exit codes for CI gating - [x] unit + integration tests for exporter and CLI - [x] telemetry pipeline mapping and docs - [x] RBAC role 'tenant_econ_exporter' and small migration script - [x] rollout plan documented in docs/tenant-unit-econ.md

Compat/migration notes: snapshots are opt-in per-tenant via the new role; exporter emits only aggregated, non-PII metrics (see schema v1). The quant-diff tool understands both packed and unpacked profile shapes produced by earlier quantizers; when an unknown field is present it treats it as "unknown-risk" and flags for manual review. This behaves as a conservative safety net (no automatic rollouts).

Testing: unit tests for exporter handler (handler_test.go) cover malformed requests, RBAC, and sample aggregation; e2e script test_tenant_econ_export.sh simulates a tenant workload, validates snapshot contents, and runs quant-diff on a golden/modified profile pair. CI shows the test matrix passed on linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 (small flake rerun once).

Changed files summary: exporter.go implements the HTTP-internal export endpoint with a 1mb compression cap; schema/v1.proto defines TenantSnapshot and QuantFingerprint; cli.py contains the quant-diff heuristic scoring and a --ci-exit flag (0=OK,1=warn,2=block). README files provide usage examples and a recommended CI snippet. Batching defaults expose a sampling_rate: 0.02 to avoid noise for large tenants but still capture representative shapes.

Review conversation (summary): Ethan requested a clearer failure mode for unknown quant fields — changed quant-diff to return code 2 and add a detailed message. Marisol asked to reduce exporter cardinality; I added aggregation buckets and switched histograms to exponential buckets for sequence lengths. Connor requested telemetry tags for "deployment_target" (hosted/dedicated/private) which I included in the snapshot. Final approvals given after CI green and one minor doc tweak.

Rollout plan: opt-in via role + feature flag for 2 weeks in staging -> enable for pilot tenants (finance, search) -> monitor unit-econ delta dashboards (dash links in docs) -> follow adoption runbook.

References: Linear ENG-2345 (tenant econ export), PM-678 (product acceptance), internal RFC link: docs/rfcs/2024-09-tenant-econ-exporter.md.

Merge: squash and merge, commit message summarizes features and adds a pointer to docs.
release_notes: Adds tenant-level unit-econ snapshot exporter (opt-in) and a quant-profile diff CLI to detect cost/latency regressions before promotion. Includes docs and CI gating examples.
